title: Sensitive Data Asset Access Audit
dataSources: Catalog audit events (`collibra:audit`, `atlan:audit`, `datahub:audit`), OpenLineage run events (`openlineage:event`), Unity Catalog audit logs, Purview scan/classification results, stewardship and access-policy change events.
app: Collibra / Alation / Atlan / DataHub / Microsoft Purview / Databricks Unity Catalog audit logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; OpenLineage/Marquez events via HEC.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=collibra:audit action IN ("asset_viewed","asset_exported","access_requested")
| stats count as events by user, action, asset_classification
| where asset_classification IN ("PII","Restricted","Confidential")
| sort - events
description: Audits access to catalogued data assets classified as sensitive so governance teams can see who is viewing or exporting regulated data.
value: Governance requires evidence of who touched sensitive data; catalog access auditing provides that trail for privacy and compliance reviews.
implementation: Ingest catalog audit events; schedule daily; alert on bulk export of restricted assets; feed compliance (cat-22).
visualization: Table of access by user/classification, timechart of sensitive access.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who looks at or exports your most sensitive data, so you can prove it is handled properly.
